text:
Lena (Product): Heads-up team — tomorrow 09:00 PT we begin a staged GA rollout for HarborStream, our low-latency hosted streaming+tooling surface. This is an opt-in GA for partners this week; well open to broader customers in phases. Please skim the GA checklist before running validation. :shipit:
Ashwin (Eng Runtime): HarborStream route = POST /v3/harbor-stream. Supports streaming, function/tool-calls, and per-route policy. It introduces a deterministic reconnect token for client resume. No forced migration from /v2 streams during the GA window.
Becky (DevEx): Quick smoke curl for partners (use canary key):
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v3/harbor-stream \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_HARBOR_CANARY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"harbor-l","input":"Create a one-line release note","tools":[{"name":"http_get","args":{"url":"https://httpbin.org/get"}}]}'
```
Becky (DevEx): JS SDK snippet:
```js
const s = await client.responses.stream('harbor-l', { input: 'Hi' });
s.on('data', chunk => console.log(chunk));
// listen for 'resume' event to handle reconnects
```
Deploy-Bot: [deploy] harborstream-canary started service=hosted-harborstream region=us-west1 at 2026-10-01T09:00:00Z :rocket:
Gwen (SRE): SRE notes: new SLIs for /v3/harbor-stream (p50/p95 latency, stream-resume-rate, structured-tool-error-rate). Canary pages if 5xx > 0.35% for 5m or stream-resume-failure-rate > 1% for 10m. Please add synthetics that exercise resume flows and multi-tool sequences.
Quota-Bot: Preview orgs get default per-route quota 12 req/s steady, burst 60. If you need temporary higher limits for validation, post org id + timeframe in #ops-requests.
Docs-Bot: Internal GA docs: https://redwood.internal/docs/harborstream-ga (internal-only). Migration guide, sample policies, SDK notes and cost implications are there — do not share externally.
Ashwin (Eng Runtime): Important infra note: HarborStream enables fine-grained token accounting for streamed tool invocations. That will affect token billing and throttling; watch the cost telemetry during tests.
Becky (DevEx): Known issues for GA testers: some long-running tool callbacks may be delivered out of order in edge cases; if you hit this, capture request_id and tag @Ashwin.
Lena (Product): Were hosting a 30m GA walk-through + live troubleshooting tomorrow 09:45 PT. RSVP: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/harborstream-ga-walkthrough. Bring repros to the session or drop them in this thread. Thanks! :pray:
